title: A Titan Rides the Belt
front_description: Anakin continues to battle flying foes on the droid factory convevor belt, avoiding deadly stampers and cutters every inch of the way. Meanwhile, R2-D2 nudges a complaining C-3PO off the factory ledge and onto a flying convevor droid. Flailing and frantic, Threepio falls from the droid and lands onto the conveyor belt below. several yards away from Anakin and Padmé.
back_description: Terryl Whitlatch's concept of a winged, hostile Geonosian.
